meta.titulo_padrao: AniBattle — Collect and battle with anime cards on Discord
meta.descricao: A Discord bot for collecting anime character cards, building a team and duelling. Pokédex, player market, tournaments and trophies. Free to play.
meta.og_descricao: Collect, trade and battle with anime character cards. Free.
meta.palavras: discord bot, anime cards, card bot, anime discord, card collecting, discord tcg, gacha bot

nav.admin_aria: Sign in to the admin dashboard

home.subtitulo: Roll cards of your favorite characters, complete your Pokédex, trade on the market and prove who builds the best team. All inside Discord, for free.
home.raras_texto: Some of the best cards in the game.
home.como_funciona_texto: Everything through slash commands. No website, no sign-up, nothing to install.
home.raridades_texto: The more famous the character, the rarer the card. And the rarer it is, the better its battle stats.
home.final_texto: Add AniBattle to your server and use {comando} to get your first card.

recursos.texto: Roll anime character cards. Five rarities, from common to master — and rarity follows how popular the character really is.
3 vs 3 duels with coins on the line. Variable damage, crits and dodges, and anyone below 40% health enters desperation mode. Comebacks happen.
Every card that passes through your inventory is registered forever — even if you sell it later.
A player-run market plus direct card-for-card trading, with both sides confirming.
28 trophies across bronze, silver and gold. Platinum only unlocks once you have all the others.
Battle rating from Bronze to Master. Beating someone stronger is worth far more.

rodape.sobre: Collect anime character cards, build your team and compete with other players. Right inside Discord.

legal.aviso_traducao: This is a courtesy translation. If the versions differ, the Portuguese text prevails.

nao_encontrado.texto: That card isn't in the deck. Maybe the number doesn't exist in the catalog, or the link is wrong.
